title: Below the Stopwatch: Checking the Performance Claims of Coding Agents in the Kernel
abstract: arXiv:2611.31460v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents open many pull requests (PRs) that claim to make software faster. Most such claims also give a reason, such as "cache the result" or "read the file once". A stopwatch can show that code got faster, but not that it got faster for the stated reason. We present Below, a pipeline that checks these reasons at the kernel level. From 1,343 runtime-performance PRs in the AIDev dataset, Below extracts the mechanism each PR claims and maps it to the kernel and hardware signals that must change if the claim is true. A build agent that never sees the claim rebuilds the code before and after each PR. Below then measures both versions with plain timing runs, hardware counters and LTTng kernel traces. Most claims are not measured: 57.3% of the PRs offer only reasoning or no evidence, and only 31.4% state an effect size. translated_title: 秒表之下：在内核层面检验编码代理的性能声明
translated_abstract: 编码代理提交了大量声称能让软件变快的拉取请求（PR）。这类声明大多还会给出理由，例如“缓存结果”或“只读取文件一次”。秒表可以显示代码变快了，却无法证明它是因为所声称的原因而变快。我们提出了Below——一个在内核层面检验这些理由的流水线。Below从AIDev数据集中的1,343个运行时性能PR中提取每个PR所声称的机制，并将其映射到如果该声明为真则必须发生变化的内核与硬件信号。一个从不接触这些声明的构建代理在每个PR应用前后重新构建代码。随后Below通过普通计时运行、硬件计数器和LTTng内核追踪来测量两个版本。结果显示大多数声明并未经过测量：57.3%的PR仅提供推理或没有任何证据，只有31.4%给出了效应大小。在82个被分析的PR中，32个运行更快，28个没有明显变化，22个运行更慢。所声称机制的预期信号……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了Below流水线，通过提取编码代理性能PR所声称的优化机制并用硬件计数器与LTTng内核追踪验证其应有的内核级信号，发现大多数性能声明缺乏实证测量，且相当一部分PR并未带来真实的性能提升。
en_tdlr: Below, a kernel-level pipeline that verifies whether the mechanisms claimed by coding agents' performance-improving PRs actually produce the expected kernel and hardware signals, revealing that most claims lack empirical measurement and many PRs show no real speedup.
